The *Padumabuddhavaṁsa* constitutes the tenth chapter (Bv 10) of the *Buddhavaṁsa*, situated within the late sutta collections of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Titled in English as "The History of the Buddha Paduma", the poem provides the legendary biography and verse account of Paduma, one of the canonical past Buddhas [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records two translations of the text in two languages [SuttaCentral].

Textual reuse and formulaic parallels across Pali literature are extensive: DharmaNexus records 348 matching passages shared across 29 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The largest share of reuse is preserved in its commentary, the *Buddhavaṃsa-aṭṭhakathā* (120 matches totaling 11,805 characters, notably including the segment range 10.1–15.4), alongside parallels in the *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. The text also exhibits extensive structural and formulaic reuse with biographical accounts of other past Buddhas within the *Buddhavaṁsa*, including the *Atthadassībuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 16), *Padumuttarabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 12), *Sumedhabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 13), *Phussabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 20), and *Nāradabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 11) [DharmaNexus]. Outside Pali, DharmaNexus automatically detects alignments with the Tibetan translation of the *Jātakanidāna* (D0032), matching segments such as 3.3–3.4 with a best plausibility score of 65 [DharmaNexus].
